ns2:course.label: Applied Microbiology Methods
ns2:course.description: Consideration, through experimentation, of properties of bacteria, yeasts, molds, and actinomycetes important to industrial processes; exploration of methods of control of microbial processes in industry and sanitation. Prerequisite: MCB 100 and MCB 101 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MCB 100 and MCB 101 or consent of instructor.
